plants.ingestionRisk: Sap from some Heracleum species contains furanocoumarins that can make exposed skin highly sensitive to sunlight.
plants.summary: A large white-flowered plant whose sap can cause a sun-activated skin reaction.
plants.avoid: Do not let your dog push through, chew or roll in damaged plants; keep sap away from skin, eyes and your own hands.
plants.elevation: Mostly valley and lower montane disturbed ground
identification: Very large white umbrella-shaped flower heads on a tall coarse plant
lookalikes: Other large Apiaceae; avoid contact when uncertain
plants.dogSafety: Avoid contact with sap and damaged stems; use veterinary advice for skin or eye exposure.
actionIfIngested: Move away from sunlight and contact a veterinarian for skin, eye or mouth exposure
plants.interestingFact: The reaction depends on both plant sap and later ultraviolet exposure.
